title: True Blue Account: ATM Fees and Out-of-Network Usage
summary: True Blue Account ATM fees: $1.00 per transaction for domestic U.S. out-of-network ATM withdrawals; 2% of the withdrawal amount for international ATM cash withdrawals with a $3.00 minimum per withdrawal. Out-of-network usage can receive monthly ATM fee rebates capped at $30. Note: ATM owners may add separate surcharges that are separate from Rho’s fees and may be accepted/canceled when disclosed.
faqs: What is the True Blue Account fee for withdrawing cash from a domestic (U.S.) non-Rho ATM?
